summary: Backend-only verification of v1.20.12 stock-search-query-routing fixes on feature/stock-search-query-routing. Ran the 5 required pytest files (35 tests) + the Node handoff shape test (6 assertions) — ALL PASS. Two independent test surfaces guard them: (1) /app/backend/tests/test_scene_routing.py — 20 pure-Python unit tests of the routing helpers + inline resolver closure; (2) /app/backend/tests/test_stock_candidates_http_routing.py — 5 respx integration tests that intercept the OUTGOING Pexels/Pixabay HTTP GETs and assert the wire-level query param; (3) /app/frontend/src/utils/handoff.test.cjs — 6 static-source assertions on Studio.jsx that catch any future attempt to call an API inside the handoff useEffect or to transform payload.brollPrompts. rca of the issue: Bug#1 RCA: /api/studio/stock-candidates previously always called _extract_stock_query(prompt) to derive the stock query, discarding the paired search_query the LLM emitted. Detailed cinematic prompts (with camera-motion + shot-type + lighting adjectives) were being sanitized instead of using the pre-computed clean query, degrading Pexels/Pixabay relevance and occasionally leaking cinematic tokens. Fix: v1.20.12 introduced StockCandidatesRequest.search_queries + an inline `resolve_query` closure that prefers the paired value verbatim and falls back to _extract_stock_query ONLY when the paired value is empty/whitespace. Verified end-to-end via respx wire-level intercepts. Bug#2 RCA: Studio.jsx handoff useEffect previously POSTed to /studio/broll-prompts to regenerate paired prompts on mount, silently replacing the script author's brollPrompts with LLM output (different wording, sometimes different count). Fix: the useEffect now directly setBulkPrompts(payload.brollPrompts.join('\n')) and setSceneOverrides(payload.brollPrompts.map(() => ({}))) — pure state-set, no server round-trip. Verified by static-source assertions in handoff.test.cjs.
